name: Urdiales del Páramo (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, white, blue, white and blue in the proportions 4:1:1:1:1.
history: The municipal flag, approved simultaneously with the arms, is rectangular of proportions 2:3, formed of five horizontal stripes in the proportions 1/2, 1/8, 1/8, 1/8 and 1/8, the upper one red, then white and blue alternating.
